transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

Yeah, um… I guess what finally pushed me to come in is my focus at work. I’m an electrician, and normally I can keep estimates and code forms straight, but lately I’ll be trying to finish one and then a tool noise, or a text, or even some idea about reorganizing the workshop just pulls me off completely.  

I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but jobs have started getting a little mixed up because of it, and that’s not really like me. Does that make sense?
Have you noticed yourself feeling more restless or fidgety lately, like you can't sit still or you're always 'on the go'?

Yeah… I mean, I guess I have been more “go-go-go” than usual. Not in a bad way exactly—at least it feels productive. I’ll go from job sites to doing bids, then come home and start rewiring test panels in the workshop.

And I’ve been starting these home-automation ideas before I’ve finished the last one, which… I know probably isn’t the best system. It’s just sitting still kind of feels like I’m wasting time, if that makes sense.
Have you noticed yourself getting more irritable or feeling down lately, even if just for short periods?

A little, yeah. I wouldn’t say I’m depressed or anything, but I’ve been… more keyed up, I guess. Like I’ll get really pumped talking about the shop, like we’re about to become the big solar outfit in town, and it feels exciting.

But then if my wife or one of the apprentices questions part of the plan, I can get sharper than I mean to. Over small stuff, honestly. I don’t like that, and I’m not trying to be a jerk—it just comes out fast sometimes. Does that count as what you mean?
Have you noticed your mood being unusually high, overly confident, or like you don’t need as much sleep lately?

Yeah… I mean, maybe a bit more than usual. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m out of control or anything, but I do get into this really pumped-up mood where I’m talking like our little shop is about to become the main solar outfit in town.

And it feels good at the time, like confidence, you know? But then if my wife or one of the apprentices questions the plan, I can kind of flip and get sharp with them over basically nothing. I’m not proud of that. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you had any recent periods—several days or more—where your mood was unusually high, excited, or irritable, even if it felt good or made you more productive at the time?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to overstate it, but I’ll get in this really pumped-up mood where I’m talking like our little shop is about to become the main solar outfit in town, like it all feels totally within reach.

And it feels good at first, productive even. But if my wife or one of the apprentices questions the plan, I can kind of flip and get sharp with them over basically nothing. I know that probably doesn’t sound great… but yeah, that’s been happening.
